Maximize Returns with Lake County, Illinois Tax Lien Sales: Earn Up to 54% in 2.5 Years

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

Get Ready to explore a unique and profitable way to invest in real estate In Lake County, Illinois. It offers an exciting opportunity with its annual tax lien sales. This is your chance to earn up to 54% in returns over 2.5 years, all while starting with a relatively low investment. Let’s dive into the details!

What Are Lake County Tax Lien Sales?

Each November, Lake County hosts a tax lien sale where investors can buy the delinquent property taxes of homeowners who haven’t paid their dues. When you buy these liens, you’re essentially paying the taxes on behalf of the property owner, and in return, you earn interest. If the homeowner doesn’t pay you back within a certain period, you might even end up owning the property.

Key Details of Lake County Tax Lien Sales

How Do Returns Work?

Imagine buying a tax lien with a 9% interest rate. You’d earn 9% every six months. If the lien remains unpaid over 2.5 years, your total return could be 54%. And if the owner still doesn’t pay, you could start foreclosure to potentially acquire the property for just the cost of back taxes.

Steps to Join the Tax Lien Sale

  1. Learn the Rules: It’s essential to know the local laws. Check out the Illinois Property Tax Code and Lake County’s rules on tax sales.
  2. Visit the Treasurer’s Website: Get all the info you need from the Lake County Tax Sale Information page.
  3. Register for the Auction: Sign up between early October and late October. You’ll need a $500 deposit, which you get back if you don’t make a purchase.
  4. Submit Your Bids: Bring your bids on a USB drive on the sale day. The system will handle the bids and award the property to the lowest bidder.
Click Here to Book a Call with Dustin Hahn

Pro Tips:

  • Buy sub-taxes on liens you already own for a fixed 12% interest rate. This protects your investment.
  • Attend the sale in person to submit your USB drive with bids.

FAQs about Lake County Tax Lien Sales

Q: What’s the redemption period?

A: It’s 2 years for vacant properties and 2.5 years for homes​.

Q: What if the owner doesn’t redeem the lien?

A: You can start foreclosure and potentially acquire the property for the cost of the back taxes​.

Q: How do I register?

A: Registration opens in early October and closes in late October. You’ll need a $500 deposit​.
